factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: Gross profit 2025 = 5,636k EUR (5.636M), margin = 15.9%; 2024 = 6,762k EUR (6.762M), margin = 17.6%.

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit for the year fell to 3.4 million euros, representing an operating profit margin of 9.5%, down from 4.3 million euros and 11.3% in the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: Operating profit 2025 = 3,359k EUR (3.359M), margin = 9.5%; 2024 = 4,332k EUR (4.332M), margin = 11.3%.

factual_claims.claim: Geographically, revenue generated in Estonia accounted for 26.1 million euros, or 73.7% of total sales revenue, while revenue generated in Latvia increased to 9.3 million euros, representing 26.3% of the total.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating Results section: 'sales revenue generated in Estonia totalled 26.1 million euros (2024: 32.5 million euros), representing 73.7% (2024: 84.6%) of total sales revenue, while sales revenue generated in Latvia amounted to 9.3 million euros (2024: 5.9 million euros), accounting for 26.3% of the Group’s total sales revenue (2024: 15.4%).'

factual_claims.claim: In addition to residential sales, the Group generated other revenue of 2.2 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating Results: 'In 2025, the Group generated other revenue in the same amount as in the comparable period, totalling 2.2 million euros, which accounted for 6.1% (2024:5.8%) of the Group’s total sales revenue.'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased by 3.4% over the year to 91.8 million euros as at December 31, 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Inventories stood at 58.9 million euros, accounting for 64.2% of total assets, and decreased from 64.1 million euros at the end of 2024 due to apartment handovers, land plot sales, and the reclassification of certain properties to investment property.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance sheet: Inventories 2025 = 58,938k EUR (58.938M), 2024 = 64,141k EUR (64.141M). Percentage of total assets: 58,938/91,835 = 64.2%. Balance Sheet section: 'Inventories decreased due to the sale of 141 apartments under real right agreements, the sale of the land plots at Paevälja 5,7,9 and Narva mnt 150, 150a, and reclassification of the properties at Narva mnt 150b and Alvari 1,1a and 5 to investment property.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents decreased to 3.8 million euros from 6.2 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance sheet: Cash and cash equivalents 2025 = 3,821k EUR (3.821M), 2024 = 6,249k EUR (6.249M).

factual_claims.claim: Total interest-bearing loan liabilities decreased to 47.7 million euros from 54.7 million euros, bringing the debt ratio down to 52.0% from 61.6%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance sheet: Total interest-bearing loan liabilities 2025 = 47,747k EUR (47.747M), 2024 = 54,688k EUR (54.688M). Key Ratios table: Debt ratio 2025 = 52.0%, 2024 = 61.6%.

factual_claims.claim: The adjusted debt ratio stood at 37.0%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Ratios table: Adjusted debt ratio 2025 = 37.0%.

factual_claims.claim: During November 2025, the company successfully completed a public bond offering, raising 8.0 million euros at a fixed annual interest rate of 9.50%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main events: 'In November 2025, the Group raised 8.0 million euros through a public bond issuance. The bonds carry a fixed annual interest rate of 9.50%.' Note 7 confirms bond issuance details.

factual_claims.claim: Total equity grew by 23.0% to 27.1 million euros, resulting in an equity ratio of 29.5%, primarily driven by non-cash contributions to the voluntary reserve of a subsidiary.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance sheet: Total equity 2025 = 27,078k EUR (27.078M), 2024 = 22,010k EUR (22.01M). Increase = (27,078 - 22,010)/22,010 = 23%. Equity ratio 2025 = 29.5% (Key Ratios). Note 11: 'The main driver of the increase in the Group`s equity was a non-cash contribution made by the non-controlling interest to the voluntary reserve of the subsidiary Hepsor PHX5 OÜ.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow for the twelve-month period was positive at 14.3 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of cash flows: 'Cash flows from (to) operating activities' for 2025 = 14,346k EUR (14.346M), rounded to 14.3M.
